# Third-party sources

- `json/json.hpp`: JSON for Modern C++ 3.11.3, Niels Lohmann, MIT.
- `modmenu/modmenu.settings.v5.schema.json`: ModMenuBedrock settings v5 schema,
  XuanDiNa, MIT. The accompanying license is in `modmenu/LICENSE`.
- `include/sdk/ModMenuBinding.h`: the same MIT-licensed ModMenu public keyboard
  binding SDK, contract 2. It has no dependency on a running ModMenu DLL.

MinHook 1.3.4 is acquired by xmake. Full required binary-distribution notices are
in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`.
